title: Ammes
summary: Raleigh names Ammes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ammes, father of the daughter by whom Nathan is reckoned among the sonnes of Dauid. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXI, §. V, subsection II, sig. 321b
